name: Survey on the Effectiveness of Information-Digital Environment in General Secondary Education from Parents' Perspective
description: This dataset contains survey responses from 5,224 parents of students in general secondary education institutions in Ukraine regarding the effectiveness of information and digital environments in schools. The survey was conducted from October 7 to October 18, 2024, during the period of the ongoing war in Ukraine.

publisher.name: Institute for Digitalisation of Education of the National Academy of Educational Sciences of Ukraine

spatialCoverage.name: Ukraine
spatialCoverage.description: Survey covers 21 regions of Ukraine and the city of Kyiv

variableMeasured.name: Demographics
variableMeasured.description: Demographic information of parents including age, gender, and region

variableMeasured.name: Child's education
variableMeasured.description: Information about children's grade level and educational institution

variableMeasured.name: Digital platforms
variableMeasured.description: Educational platforms and digital tools used by schools

variableMeasured.name: Communication channels
variableMeasured.description: Methods of communication between parents and teachers

variableMeasured.name: Digital skills
variableMeasured.description: Assessment of children's digital skills and learning independence

variableMeasured.name: Technical resources
variableMeasured.description: Access to devices and technical support for distance learning

variableMeasured.name: Improvement suggestions
variableMeasured.description: Parents' suggestions for improving the digital environment in schools

funder.name: National Academy of Educational Sciences of Ukraine
